name: unimod
author: kirin
description: Intelligent auto-moderation using VADER sentiment analysis and GLM5 AI for accurate rule violation detection. Monitors whitelisted channels and alerts moderators to potential violations.
install_msg: UniMod loaded! Use `[p]set api openai YOUR_API_KEY` to set your API key, then `[p]unimod whitelist` to add channels to monitor.
end_user_data_statement: This cog buffers message content and user IDs in memory for moderation analysis. Owner-enabled diagnostic mode may retain a redacted AI response for at most one hour; the file is removed on expiry or unload.
